result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back in all six listings plus the code lookup. The full suite passes (608 tests, BUILD SUCCESS).

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`. The 200 limit is my choice; the task didn't specify one. An over-long text will fail at insert.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component. It is null when the promotion has none.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: `createPromotion` takes an optional `description` as a sixth argument. Blank becomes null, as with `category`. The existing five-argument version still exists and delegates with null, so the demo data and existing tests are untouched.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. The lookup by code, active-on-date, active-in-region, category, best-for-category-on-date, and unused-in-period queries all select it and map it into `Promotion`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionInAllListings` test. It creates one promotion with a description and one without, then checks the text in every listing, the best-promotion lookup, and the code lookup.

I did not commit.
